fixture_notes: Two matches including NULL, one unmatched parent, and an orphan child distinguish COUNT(*) from COUNT(value).
determinism_notes: Grouped results have a unique parent ID and explicit ordering.
setup: CREATE TABLE parents (id INT PRIMARY KEY)
CREATE TABLE children (id INT PRIMARY KEY, parent_id INT, value INT)

steps.sql: SELECT p.id, COUNT(c.value) AS present_values, COUNT(*) AS joined_rows FROM parents p LEFT JOIN children c ON c.parent_id = p.id GROUP BY p.id ORDER BY p.id
